numan.hero_note: Choose your preferences and budget. Get a starting shortlist, compare alternatives, and build your own bundle from different skincare brands.
numan.quiz_intro: Choose a format, pack preference and product budget. See available starting picks, then adjust your bundle.
numan.details_heading:
From first pick
to final bundle.
numan.detail_one: Choose one step at a time
numan.detail_one_body: Browse the products available for each routine step. You can replace a selection, skip a step, or start again.
numan.detail_two_body: You choose the products and pack sizes; the builder adds their prices together. A bundle is not automatically discounted. Review shipping, taxes and any applicable discounts at checkout.
numan.detail_three: Check the details before you buy
numan.detail_three_body: Open each product to review its pack size and directions. Products may arrive separately. If ingredients or delivery timing are unclear, contact us before placing an order.
numan.builder_intro: Choose one product per step, or just the steps you need. Selecting another product in the same step replaces your previous pick.
numan.empty_step_note: There are no products in this step. Continue with the rest of your routine.
numan.no_js_builder: To use the guided builder, enable JavaScript. You can also shop and add products directly.
numan.shipping_note: Shipping and taxes calculated at checkout.
numan.added: Your selection has been added to the bag.
numan.add_error: We could not confirm the update. Please check your bag before trying again.
numan.add_rejected: Your selection could not be added.
numan.cleanse_description: Compare the available cleansers and choose one for this step.
numan.treat_description: Browse serums and essences. This step is optional—choose one or keep moving.
numan.moisturize_description: Compare creams and gels, then choose your size.
numan.protect_description: Browse the available daytime SPF products.
numan.other_description: Finish with an accessory, lip gloss, or one of the available sets.
numan.routine_note: Morning, evening, or a little of both. Explore each step and choose what belongs in your routine.
numan.five_questions: A few choices · no email required
numan.compare_help: Choose 2 or 3 products to view together.
numan.compare_limit: You can compare up to 3 products at a time.
numan.compare_note: Check the product details and ingredients before choosing.
numan.evening_note: SPF is a daytime step. It stays available here if you are also shopping for your morning routine.
numan.rose_edit_note: Explore creams and gels. Compare the details, choose your size, and make room in your routine.
numan.single_bottle_shown: Single bottle shown. Check your selected pack size.
numan.pack_note: A pack counts as one selection. Check the bottle count in your chosen option.
numan.quiz_guide_note: Choose your preferences and product budget. See why each pick fits, compare available alternatives, then edit your bundle.
numan.quiz_review_note: These choices match shopping preferences, not a skin diagnosis. Check the full ingredients and product directions before deciding what suits your skin.
numan.quiz_step_hint: Choose what you want to shop for. Your answers stay in this browser session.
numan.search_bundle: Find a product in this step
numan.filter_available_budget: Show options within my remaining product budget
numan.filter_empty: No products match these choices. Try another search or turn off the budget filter.
numan.quiz_start_note: A few choices. No email required.
numan.quiz_products_note: See a shortlist with prices and reasons.
numan.quiz_review_note_short: Swap products and check the total.
numan.access_note: Use the storefront password to view the shop. Newsletter signup is optional and does not unlock access.
numan.access_newsletter: Prefer to hear when we launch?
numan.quiz_texture: Which moisturizer format would you like?
numan.quiz_serum: Would you like an optional serum or essence?
numan.quiz_pack: Which pack size would you prefer?
numan.quiz_use: Start a new bundle with these picks
numan.quiz_replace: This replaces any saved builder selection. Nothing is added to your bag until you choose to add it.
numan.quiz_empty: No available match within this product budget. Change your answers or browse the catalog.
numan.quiz_partial: Some requested items have no available match within your budget. You can adjust your answers or add alternatives in the builder.
numan.quiz_day_note: Shopping for daytime? This shortlist does not include sunscreen. Check your existing routine separately.
numan.quiz_evening_note: Review each product’s directions before adding it to your evening routine.
numan.quiz_reason_moisturize: Matches your moisturizer format and fits within your product budget.
numan.quiz_reason_treat: Matches your optional serum and pack preferences, within the remaining product budget.
numan.quiz_shipping: Shipping and taxes are extra and are shown at checkout. This is a product shortlist, not a complete skincare routine.
numan.quiz_imported: Your quiz picks are ready to review. You can swap or remove any item.
numan.quiz_import_changed: Some quiz picks are no longer available. Review the remaining selection and current prices.
numan.quiz_import_missing: Your shortlist is no longer saved in this browser. Take the quiz again or choose products below.
numan.product_help_options_note: Select the size or pack you want above. The selected option and price are the ones added to your bag. Styled photos may show a single bottle; check the pack label.
numan.product_help_delivery_note: Products may arrive in separate parcels. Check delivery and return details before ordering; ask us about timing for the specific product if you need it by a certain date.
numan.product_help_choice_note: The quiz compares a limited set of available products by format, pack preference and product budget. It does not confirm whether products are suitable for your skin or work together. You can swap or remove any pick.
numan.quiz_method: We currently compare a limited set of available moisturizers, serums and essences. Format, optional serum, pack size and product budget determine eligibility. The lowest-priced eligible options are starting picks; you can swap alternatives below. Routine timing changes the guidance, not the ingredient assessment. Similar answers can give the same picks. We do not assess allergies, skin conditions or ingredient compatibility.
numan.search_help: No exact match? Browse a category or use the quiz to find a starting point.
numan.budget_variant_hint: An affordable option is available. Choose a smaller pack below.
numan.contact_intro: Ask about a product, delivery or an existing order. Include the product name or your order number so we can help.
numan.returns_contact: Questions about a return or damaged item? Contact us here.
numan.quiz_faq_answer: The quick quiz suggests available starting picks by moisturizer format, optional serum, pack preference and product budget. You can edit the picks in the bundle builder. It does not assess skin conditions or ingredient compatibility.
numan.meta_home: Explore skincare, compare available sizes and packs, and build your own bundle with a preference and budget quiz.
numan.meta_collection: Browse available skincare and accessories. Compare sizes, packs and prices, then choose products for your bundle.
numan.meta_quiz: Find available skincare starting picks by shopping preferences and product budget. Review the choices and customize your bundle.
numan.meta_builder: Choose skincare products one step at a time, compare pack sizes and track your bundle subtotal before adding it to your bag.
numan.meta_contact: Contact us with product, delivery or order questions. Include the product name or order number with your message.
numan.ingredient_help: Need the full ingredient list or help checking a label? Ask us before ordering. The quiz does not verify ingredient compatibility.
numan.compare_option_help: Prices below are for the stated options. Select an option to view that exact product variant.
numan.bundle_price_clarity: Your bundle is the sum of the products you choose. There is no automatic bundle discount. Shipping, taxes and any applicable discounts are shown at checkout.
numan.care_pack_body: A single bottle and a multipack are different options. Check the size, bottle count and selected price before adding to your bag.
numan.care_delivery_body: Products may arrive separately. Review delivery information or ask us about a particular item before placing your order.
numan.care_help_body: Need an ingredient list, label details or help with an option? Include the product name when you contact us.
numan.multi_brand: Different brands. Your choice of routine.
numan.multi_brand_detail: We bring products from different brands into one shopping experience. Each item keeps its own brand and packaging; bundling does not make them one formula or confirm that they work together.
numan.quiz_one_match: This is the only option currently matching these preferences and remaining budget. Change your answers to explore a different format or pack.
numan.quiz_compatibility: These are shopping matches—not a verified ingredient-compatible routine. Read each label and ask us for missing product information before buying.
numan.quiz_choice_updated: Selection updated. Review your new subtotal below.
numan.quiz_alternative_note: Each option shows its full pack price. Only alternatives that keep your current shortlist within budget are shown.
numan.trust_product_body: Check the brand, packaging, selected size and directions on this product. If the full ingredient list or supplier details are missing, ask us before ordering. We do not treat quiz matches as proof of suitability or authenticity.
